notes.title: Patch Version 2.10 Released
notes.content:
Updated particle effects for the magic and combat animations.

Increased the amount of XP earned per kill.

Fixed the issue where enemy nameplates would stack and not go away.

Added an Exit button to the option menu.

notes.title: Patch Version 2.08 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixes the issue where the battle(Rufus) after exiting the Undercrypt would break, causing the enemies not to take damage.

This also fixes the issue where the Kill The Bounty Hunters quest would not complete. You will have to start a new game.

notes.title: Patch Version 2.07 Released
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31322828/e4f5573f2020f8ef75ead8203c4fbf18f016a04f.jpg[/img]

Optimized the combat code. The framerate is much more stable during battles with enemies.

NPC will now distance themselves a bit more from the player rather than pressing up against them.

Adjusted camera angle and height during combat while in strafe mode.

Fixed the issue where the Choas Helmet would not display.

Fixed issue where your hair would show through helmets after loading a game.

Fixed an issue that would cause game to temporarily freeze and cause black textures after changing options to LOW.

Reduced the global volume of all sounds.

Zuri no longer heals all the time during combat, there is a 40 -70 percent chance he will heal when at 10% health.

You can now remap the Block button/key in the options (Esc key).

notes.title: Patch Version 2.06
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where you could not interact with items if you were really close to them.

Fixed issue where Rufus and his minions could go through the cliff walls.

Fixed an issue where areas would not display on save game slots.

Added a "wake up" animation to the intro.

Fixed an issue that caused some loot chest to sink below to the bottom floor level.

Added loot chests to The Undercrypt intro.

notes.content:
